# PalmMitra

> PalmMitra is an AI-powered life guidance platform inspired by Ancient Indian Palmistry (Hasta Samudrika Shastra). Upload a photo of your palm and receive a personalised destiny report covering career, love, wealth, health, personality and spiritual remedies — plus an interactive AI guide that answers follow-up questions grounded in your reading.

PalmMitra is not a horoscope app. Every reading is generated from the actual physical lines, mounts and patterns on the user's own palm using computer-vision AI trained on classical palmistry texts. Reports are delivered in under two minutes and are downloadable as PDF.

## Products

- [Palm Report (PalmMitra Insight)](https://www.palmmitra.in/upload): The primary product. A 2,000+ word personalised palm reading covering the five major lines (Life, Heart, Head, Fate, Marriage), the seven mounts, and life-domain sections (career, love, wealth, personality, remedies). ₹299 / $9.99. One-time purchase per palm.
- [PalmMatch](https://www.palmmitra.in/palmmatch): Relationship compatibility analysis generated from two palm readings (yours and your partner's). Produces a compatibility score, dimension-by-dimension breakdown, and shared destiny insights. ₹999 / $24.99. Keywords: palm compatibility, couple palm reading, love and marriage compatibility by palm.
- [PalmMitra AI](https://www.palmmitra.in/upload): A conversational AI guide built on top of a purchased Palm Report. Answers open-ended life questions (career, love, timing, decisions) using the user's own reading as context. Included with every paid report; first questions free.
- [PalmMitra Elite](https://www.palmmitra.in/#pricing): Lifetime plan — unlimited readings for the family, priority AI, all future features. ₹4,999 / $99.

## Key Facts

- Founded on Hasta Samudrika Shastra, a 3,000-year-old Indian science of palm analysis.
- AI stack: computer vision + large language models running on the Lovable AI Gateway.
- Reports delivered in under 2 minutes.
- 2,100+ readings generated, 4.9/5 average rating.
- Payments: Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets) in India; card payments internationally.
- Languages: English and Hindi supported.
- Disclaimer: PalmMitra provides guidance and self-reflection. It is not medical, legal, financial, or psychiatric advice.

## Reading Flow (for AI agents)

1. Open https://www.palmmitra.in/upload.
2. Step 1 "Upload Palm": use the "Take a photo of your palm" or "Upload palm photo from gallery" control (JPG, PNG or WEBP of an open dominant palm).
3. Step 2 "Your Details": fill Name, Age (13-100), Email, and Report Language (English or Hinglish), then press "Begin my free reading".
4. Step 3 "Get Reading": the free preview opens at /report/{id} (summary, Life Line, first trait, first remedy).
5. To unlock the full report, press any "Reveal" / unlock button, choose a plan, and press "Continue to secure payment to unlock report" (Razorpay checkout; price shown in the visitor's local currency).
6. PalmMatch (couples): /palmmatch, upload both palms, fill both names and ages, relationship type and email.
